profile.subtitleJa: アンモン人の王として記される人物
profile.summaryJa: アンモン人の王ナハシュが死に、その子ハヌンが王位を継いだと記されています。
profile.identityNoteJa: ナハシュはハヌンの父としても記されます。

facts.textJa: ダビデは、ナハシュが自分に親切を示したことを理由に、ハヌンへ使者を送りました。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: After this, Nahash the king of the children of Ammon died, and his son reigned in his place.

David said, “I will show kindness to Hanun the son of Nahash, because his father showed kindness to me.” So David sent messengers to comfort him concerning his father. David’s servants came into the land of the children of Ammon to Hanun to comfort him.
